import datetime, hashlib, json, math
from pathlib import Path
import wandb
from wandb.apis.public.history import SampledHistoryScan
from audit_subset_history import TRAIN_KEYS, FINAL_KEY
R=Path('scratch/20261108-alpha025-artifact-audit'); out=R/'history';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
native=json.loads(Path('scratch/20261108-parallel-r01-alpha025-native-crash/native-progress.json').read_text())['row']
native['id']=native['run_id']
request=json.loads((R/'request.json').read_text())
assert native['config_identity_verified'] and native['state']=='crashed' and native['job_id']==request['accepted_job']
assert request['accepted_source']=='923d79510475df3ed0fef53d40b3290ae4c90fce'
assert request['config_sha256']=='86caaa955d802294e55751575219539451d6061d63a5b5d1fabe02ce56160fb8'
api=None

def page(kind,keys,start,stop,samples):
 global api
 cache=out/f'{kind}-{start}-{stop}.json'
 if cache.exists(): return json.loads(cache.read_text())['rows']
 guard=cache.with_suffix('.started.json')
 spec={'keys':keys,'minStep':start,'maxStep':stop,'samples':samples}
 guard.open('x').write(json.dumps({'run':native['id'],'spec':spec,'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()}))
 if api is None:api=wandb.Api()
 response=api.client.execute(SampledHistoryScan.QUERY,variable_values={'entity':'marin-community','project':'marin','run':native['id'],'spec':json.dumps(spec)})
 rows=response['project']['run']['sampledHistory'][0]
 cache.write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'query_spec':spec,'response':response},indent=2)+'\n')
 return rows

allrows={};duplicates={};missing={}
for kind,keys in [('train',['global_step',*TRAIN_KEYS]),('eval',['global_step',FINAL_KEY,'_runtime'])]:
 raw=[]
 for start in range(0,37335,1000):raw.extend(page(kind,keys,start,min(start+1000,37335),1000))
 unique={};dups=[]
 for row in raw:
  label=row['global_step'];assert isinstance(label,(int,float)) and not isinstance(label,bool) and int(label)==label and 0<=label<37335
  if label in unique:
   assert unique[label]==row;dups.append(label)
  unique[label]=row
 if kind=='train':
  for label in sorted(set(range(37335))-set(unique)):
   if label != 37334 and not (label-1 in unique and label+1 in unique):continue
   found=[r for r in page('repair',keys,label,label+1,10) if r['global_step']==label]
   if found:assert len(found)==1;unique[label]=found[0]
 for row in unique.values():
  for key in keys:assert isinstance(row[key],(int,float)) and not isinstance(row[key],bool) and math.isfinite(row[key])
 allrows[kind]=[unique[k] for k in sorted(unique)];duplicates[kind]=dups
 missing[kind]=sorted(set(range(37335))-set(unique)) if kind=='train' else [37334] if 37334 not in unique else []
report={'observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),'source':request['accepted_source'],'run_id':native['id'],'native_metadata_requeried':False,'state_from_cache':native['state'],'train_rows':len(allrows['train']),'eval_rows':len(allrows['eval']),'missing':missing,'identical_duplicates':duplicates,'rows':allrows,'scientifically_complete':False,'scope':'Targeted history only from original crashed run; no metadata/state poll; local recovered rows not inserted.'}
(R/'history-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='rows'}))

        blob=client.bucket(bucket).get_blob(path+'/'+name)
        if blob is None or blob.size>=1_000_000:

        raw=blob.download_as_bytes(if_generation_match=blob.generation,checksum='crc32c')

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
import google.auth
from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
import tensorstore as ts
out=Path('scratch/20261108-alpha025-artifact-audit/counter-37335-metadata')
metadata=json.loads((out/'validated.json').read_text())
assert metadata['expected_counter']==37335 and metadata['status']=='PERMANENT_CHECKPOINT_METADATA_VALIDATED'
cache=out/'counter.json'
if cache.exists():
    result=json.loads(cache.read_text())
else:
    (out/'counter.started').open('x').write(metadata['checkpoint'])
    creds,_=google.auth.default(scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/devstorage.read_only'])
    creds.refresh(Request())
    spec={'driver':'zarr3','kvstore':{'driver':'ocdbt','base':{'driver':'http','base_url':'https://storage.googleapis.com/'+metadata['checkpoint'][5:]+'/','headers':['Authorization: Bearer '+creds.token]},'path':'step'}}
    try:arr=ts.open(spec,open=True,read=True,write=False).result().read().result()
    except Exception as exc:raise RuntimeError(str(exc).replace(creds.token,'[REDACTED]')) from None
    assert arr.shape==() and int(arr)==37335
    result={'counter':int(arr),'dtype':str(arr.dtype),'shape':list(arr.shape),'scalar_sha256':hashlib.sha256(arr.tobytes()).hexdigest(),'checkpoint':metadata['checkpoint'],'scope':'Read-only stored scalar counter; no full checkpoint byte audit or restore.'}
    cache.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
assert result['counter']==37335
print(json.dumps(result))
